dedupe_keys.name: agent based model of industrial symbiosis in the juanchito industrial park manizales colombia netlogo with emergy assessment

description: A NetLogo model of how by-product exchanges between firms form in an urban industrial park. The Zenodo record says firms are agents described by their raw material, energy, product, by-product, waste, wastewater and emission flows; each iteration finds technically feasible exchanges, applies economic and operational acceptance rules and formalises those that pass, producing an updated material flow structure that feeds an emergy-based sustainability assessment (EYR, ELR and ESI). Inputs come from the Registro Único Ambiental for manufacturing firms in 2017, held for Caldas by Corpocaldas, with firms identified only by CIIU activity code. Published on 30 July 2026 by Guillermo Andrés Fuentes Barrera under CC BY 4.0, the downloadable files (about 0.6 MB) are the NetLogo 6.1.1 model, the input CSV, an ODD description, scenario outputs, emergy matrices and iteration traces; code and data are in Spanish, with a glossary. Coverage is one industrial park. Caveats: a single site, and the Spanish variable names follow Colombian classifications. For simulation it shows how shared water, energy and waste links between firms can form, which adds interdependencies that a failure at one plant would pass on. Related catalogue records include the industrial symbiosis network implementation ABM and the MAESTRI industrial symbiosis case library.
